title: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2: Local Government in Rural Areas
introduction: Grassroots Democracy – Part 2: Local Government in Rural Areas is explored through people, places, time, institutions and economic or cultural relationships. Key source-grounded themes include Grassroots Democracy – Part 2: Local Government in Rural Areas, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Gurukul reorganises these into questions, comparisons, evidence tasks and real-life applications without reproducing textbook prose.
